import pathlib
programs=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u033/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''from collections import deque, defaultdict

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            shape = frozenset((y-min(a for a,b in cells), x-min(b for a,b in cells)) for y,x in cells)
            comps.append((color, cells, shape))
    prototypes = {}
    for color, cells, shape in comps:
        if color != 1:
            prototypes.setdefault(shape, color)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for color, cells, shape in comps:
        if color == 1 and shape in prototypes:
            replacement = prototypes[shape]
            for y, x in cells:
                out[y][x] = replacement
    return out
'''
